Night Serum, tested on sensitive skin by an independent lab.

Results from an independent 28-day consumer study of 112 women aged 25 to 60 with self-declared sensitive skin, using Night Serum once a day; individual results vary. Percentages are of participants who agreed in a self-assessment questionnaire. Patch test before first use: apply a little behind the ear and wait 48 hours. Stop using it if irritation occurs. For external use only; avoid the eye area. Keep out of reach of children. Store below 25 C away from direct sunlight and use within six months of opening. Free delivery on orders over $40 to mainland addresses only. Lumen & Fig Ltd., 2026.
